attemptScope: First attempt launched from the Codex/MSIX environment

result.message: Проверка обновления не завершена. Установленная версия сохранена.

operatorObservations.clientLog: FileNotFound for release.json in the per-user staging directory; the ordinary-user shell could see the staged files.
operatorObservations.confirmedCause: The application launched from Codex inherited MSIX filesystem redirection. Staged files physically resided in the Codex package LocalCache/Local tree while the SYSTEM broker addressed the real user LocalAppData directory.
operatorObservations.causeScope: Test launch environment; no production code change was made for this finding.

sourceEvidence.verification: Read-only result, installed executable version and absence of the transaction MSI log; UI recovery and client-log details were recorded by the operator.
sourceEvidence.causeVerification: Broker investigation confirmed the physical staged files under the Codex MSIX package cache instead of the real user profile.

limits: This is a failed pre-install attempt, not a Windows Installer rollback.
This report retains the failed Codex/MSIX test-launch attempt after its environment cause was confirmed.
Successful application-driven installation and restart from an ordinary Windows launch are documented separately in host-in-app-update-2.0.1-to-2.0.2-native.json.
